user.description: Connect the SIP Phone Gateway add-on through MQTT. Configure the SIP extension username and password in the add-on, then enter the same server address and account slot here. The optional Assist URI is the Home Assistant Voice over IP endpoint used by connect_assist.

error.invalid_connection: Use a SIP server address, account slot 1 to 3, and MQTT topics without wildcard characters.

abort.already_configured: This SIP extension gateway is already configured.
